decisionScope: Additional maintained dictionary sources for the current Dictionary Ecosystem v2 delivery. This is not approval for future product cycles or user-owned local import.

summary.conditionalDeliveryIssue206: No source passed GO; do not activate #206 for a curated source in this cycle.

decisions.intendedRole: Native Chinese-to-English dictionary for Chinese-text selection; it must not be reverse-indexed and described as authoritative EN-to-zh-CN data.
decisions.expectedUserBenefit: Could add local Chinese lookup in English, with Simplified/Traditional forms, pinyin, and English glosses.
decisions.overlap: Adds a direction absent from the current EN -> zh-CN-only structured lookup path; it does not improve English-to-Chinese recall.

exactArtifact.versioningLimitation: The exact artifact is pinned by timestamp, ETag and observed hashes because MDBG supplies a mutable current URL without an immutable release ID or published checksum.

evidence: The exact artifact header and current editor download page name CC BY-SA 4.0.
The official CC-CEDICT project home, last modified 2025-05-31, still names CC BY-SA 3.0. Its older revision date makes staleness plausible, but no explicit supersession statement was located.
The project identifies MDBG as publisher and says reviewed community edits are included in releases.
legalProvenanceGate.redistribution: Not approved until the official license-version conflict is resolved and attribution/share-alike notices are designed for the intended derived pack.
legalProvenanceGate.directUpstreamAcquisition: The public MDBG export is downloadable; this does not remove the license-version ambiguity or constitute TranslateFlow source approval.

smokeCorpus.method: Parse exact UTF-8 export; perform exact simplified-headword lookup for 20 named common Chinese fixture terms, check pinyin/dual-script fields, and inspect polyphonic/ambiguous-character row counts. No source text was copied into a fixture.

productQualityGate.upstreamQualityDisclosure: The official syntax guidance describes v1 as historical and says the current database contains infelicities, inaccuracies, omissions and actual errors. The retrieved MDBG release identifies itself as v1; its entries are not accompanied by an independent TranslateFlow gold-quality signal.
productQualityGate.interpretation: The smoke sample confirms the advertised direction and useful form/pinyin structure. It is not a gold-labeled definition-quality benchmark: no independent zh->en correctness/top-result audit, contextual ambiguity scoring, or user-visible flow exists for this direction. TranslateFlow cannot infer accuracy from corpus size or pinyin/form coverage; this is insufficient for a product GO.

technicalFitGate.evidence: Current structured selection and TFLex builder/import recipes accept sourceLanguage=en and targetLanguage=zh-CN; no CC-CEDICT text importer or zh->en lookup contract exists.
technicalFitGate.latencyMemoryAndUpdateCost: Not measured; source endpoint is mutable and has no upstream checksum/version identifier.

securityPrivacyGate.futureBoundary: Would require explicit user-triggered acquisition from the MDBG origin and bounded local parsing. The text includes no identified executable/remote resources; no integrated network, parser, memory, or privacy test was performed.

knownLimitations: Official pages disagree on CC BY-SA version.
No current zh->en structured lookup path or adapter.
Smoke coverage does not establish definition correctness or sense ranking.
No immutable upstream version/checksum is published.
Not an EN->zh-CN source and not an Official pack.
revisitConditions: MDBG/CC-CEDICT resolves the applicable license for the exact artifact.
A zh->en product slice is explicitly approved and benchmarked on a gold-labeled Chinese corpus.
Catalog adapter, bounded parsing and browser/runtime budgets pass.

decisions.intendedRole: English semantic/sense supplement, not an EN->zh-CN bilingual replacement.
decisions.expectedUserBenefit: Potentially improve local English sense structure, POS, pronunciation and semantic relations.
decisions.overlap: The current Core semantic pack is already built from Princeton WordNet 3.0 aligned to Chinese Open Wordnet. OEWN derives from Princeton WordNet and therefore overlaps the existing semantic backbone; it contributes no Chinese translation field.

existingStructuredBaseline.incrementalOewnComparison: Not run. The mapped-rate figure describes the baseline only and is not evidence that OEWN would improve or worsen it.

legalProvenanceGate.evidence: The exact revision LICENSE.md says OEWN further development is CC BY 4.0 and the underlying Princeton WordNet terms continue to apply to WordNet data; WNDB_License.txt carries the WordNet notice. The selected JSON ZIP contains data JSON files only, so notices would need to be supplied separately.
legalProvenanceGate.redistribution: Potentially compatible with a curated derivative only after preserving both WordNet and OEWN attribution/license notices. Does not satisfy #122 Official source/trust-root approval.

productQualityGate.upstreamQualityDisclosure: The OEWN repository describes the project as derived from Princeton WordNet and says quality/veracity may differ from Princeton WordNet; it invites corrections and improvements. This requires comparison against the already-used PWN3/COW baseline rather than an assumption of superiority.

artifactShapeSample.method: Count exact 2025 JSON lemma/POS/sense objects for the project quality baseline's overloaded English words; do not infer Chinese translations from definitions.

productQualityGate.interpretation: The export contains rich English sense/POS structure, as expected for an English WordNet. No head-to-head quality or incremental-coverage comparison against the existing PWN3/COW Core was run; the sample does not establish that OEWN improves this product's EN->zh-CN answer, and it supplies no Chinese translations. Product quality gate is not met.

technicalFitGate.latencyMemoryAndUpdateCost: Not measured in TranslateFlow. Separate catalog pack would duplicate much of Core's PWN-derived semantic material and add a second WordNet index.

securityPrivacyGate.futureBoundary: Official origin is en-word.net; a future install would be explicit, verify exact bytes, parse locally with bounded ZIP/JSON limits, and make no runtime remote requests. No integration, network capture, memory, or parser test was performed.

knownLimitations: No incremental quality/coverage benchmark or runtime cost measurement.
Both OEWN CC BY 4.0 and underlying WordNet notices must be preserved.
revisitConditions: A measured PWN3-vs-OEWN incremental benchmark identifies user-visible value.
The product has a user-facing English semantic/monolingual supplement role.
A bounded adapter and dual-license attribution packaging are reviewed.

findings.decision: Existing exact release remains NO-SHIP: the already committed source lock confirms identity/license and the quality decision documents misleading zh-CN/polysemy/technical results. No newer release or materially new quality evidence was found; do not re-review or revive it under a new name.

findings.existingDecision: NO-GO for this exact source/extractor/projection in #121; see docs/WIKTIONARY_RICH_POC.md and lexicon/quality-decisions/wikimedia-enwiktionary-20260901-rich.json.
findings.decision: No materially new source/license/schema/quality evidence was found in this search. Preserve #121 decision and do not rename or re-register the same path.

No additional exact upstream-owned source with a current immutable artifact, clear content provenance/license, and evidence of zh-CN product quality was qualified in this scoped primary-source search. Absence is acceptable; this is not a claim that no such source exists anywhere.

maintainedEnToZhCnSearch.commercialDictionaryBoundary: No Oxford, Longman, Collins, Cambridge or community MDX bytes were obtained or considered for curated redistribution. Commercial dictionaries remain user-owned compatibility targets unless the rights holder or authorized distributor offers a suitable exact artifact and rights.

ecdictReleaseCheck.decision: No new ECDICT release/version/artifact beyond the already-reviewed 1.0.28 MDX and already-integrated exact 2025 CSV snapshot was found. Keep the current sourceVersion/contentDate distinctions and curated-upstream/local-acquisition boundary. Do not re-label the 2017 MDX as current content.

exactArtifactDownloadAndHashCommands: curl -fsSL https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/export/cedict/cedict_1_0_ts_utf-8_mdbg.txt.gz -o cedict.txt.gz; sha256sum cedict.txt.gz; gzip -cd cedict.txt.gz > cedict.txt; sha256sum cedict.txt; parse non-comment UTF-8 rows
curl -fsSL https://en-word.net/static/english-wordnet-2025-json.zip -o english-wordnet-2025-json.zip; sha256sum english-wordnet-2025-json.zip; unzip -l english-wordnet-2025-json.zip
reproducibility.localArtifactStorage: Research downloads were stored under /tmp/translateflow-205 only; source bytes are not committed or included in product/release packages.
reproducibility.benchmarkLimitation: The CC-CEDICT fixture is a structural smoke sample, not an independent translation gold set. OEWN checks are artifact-shape counts, not a relative product-quality benchmark. Both final product-quality gates therefore remain NO-GO.

qualityReproduction.ccCedict: Decode the locked gzip as UTF-8; ignore blank/comment rows; parse `traditional simplified [pinyin] /glosses/`; look up each exact fixture term against the simplified field; count a pinyin hit when the bracket field is nonempty; count a distinct Traditional form when the first and second headword fields differ. Count row multiplicity for 行, 重, 乐 and 长. The committed fixture list and expected aggregates are in the CC-CEDICT decision record.
qualityReproduction.oewn: Read each entries-*.json member of the locked 2025 JSON ZIP; for each named lemma count `sense` array length under each POS key. This measures schema shape only and deliberately makes no definition-quality or Chinese-translation claim.
